description: ComAp InteliLite 4 genset controller. Single controller model with Modbus TCP support.
notes: Holding register access only (no input registers). The controller identifies itself via a text string at registers 1307-1322 (16 registers, but only first 12 characters are meaningful). Serial number is not available via Modbus; the custom name (registers 3000-3007) is used as device identifier instead. Register hole maximum is 0 (no gaps allowed in read groups). Power registers use scale factor 0.001 (raw value in kW). Invalid values: 0x8000 for u16 signed registers, -0x8000 for s16, 0x80000000 for u32.

engine_oil_pressure.description: Engine oil pressure. Raw value divided by 10 for kPa.

engine_operating_hours.description: Total engine operating hours. Raw value in 1/360 hour increments, multiply by 10 for seconds.

ac_total_power.description: Generator total active power. Raw value in kW, multiply by 1000 for watts.

ac_l1_power.description: Generator L1 phase active power. Raw value in kW, multiply by 1000 for watts.

ac_l2_power.description: Generator L2 phase active power. Raw value in kW, multiply by 1000 for watts.

ac_l3_power.description: Generator L3 phase active power. Raw value in kW, multiply by 1000 for watts.

fuel_level.description: Fuel tank level. Invalid value 0x8000 indicates no sensor connected.

status_code.description: Engine status code: 0=Init, 1=Ready, 2=Not ready, 3=Prestart, 4=Cranking, 5=Pause, 6=Starting, 7=Running, 8=Loaded, 9=Unloading, 10=Cooling, 11=Stop, 12=Shutdown, 13=Ventilate, 14=Emergency manual, 15=Soft loading, 16=WaitStop, 17=Venting

controller_identifier.description: Controller identification string. Must read all 16 registers; only first 12 characters are meaningful.

remote_start_mode.description: Operating mode: 0=OFF, 1=MANUAL, 2=AUTO, 3=TEST. Remote start enabled when mode is AUTO (2).

custom_name.description: Controller custom name. Used as device unique identifier since serial number is not available via Modbus.

start_stop_coil.description: Remote start/stop coil. Write True to start, False to stop. See ComAp global manual page 204.
